description: Analyze a log file. POST raw log text (or an upload_id from the uploads tool, up to 5MB) and get: level breakdown + time range, error clusters (messages normalized so variable ids/numbers collapse into one signature, with counts + first/last seen + a sample), a timeline, detected anomalies (error spikes, retry storms, new error signatures, log gaps/outages, level-ratio shifts) with evidence, and templated recommendations. Handles JSON-lines and plain formats (ISO8601/syslog/CLF/epoch timestamps). Deterministic, single-pass, no LLM.

upload_id.description: Alternative: a log file uploaded via the uploads tool.

name: log_analyzer
